description: EV charging stations nearest to a coordinate, with their connectors (type, AC/DC, power) and how many are free, in use or out of order right now, plus opening hours and prices. Use city "freeway" for the freeway service areas. Example: lat 25.0478, lon 121.517, city "Taipei", connector "CCS2".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, ...) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, ...), or "freeway" for the freeway service areas.

connector.description: Only stations with this connector: CCS1, CCS2, CHAdeMO, Tesla (TPC), J1772 (Type 1) or Type2 (Mennekes).

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default 5).

want.description: "free" (default): only stations with a free connector of the wanted kind right now; "any": every station.

name: ev_charger_nearby
title: Nearest EV chargers
